claim_boundary: The cases are controlled semantic fixtures, not a prevalence sample of public or private pull requests.
Passing the corpus does not prove source-level residue correctness, defect recall, review-time savings, retention, or product-market fit.
Force-push, rebase, and restack labels describe constructed histories; metadata alone does not infer the rewrite mechanism.
Base identities and active re-review requests define the target contract even where the current CLI has not yet collected those fields.
Transition-key assertions prove deterministic identity separation only; they are not signatures or authentication evidence.
description: A deterministic, network-free corpus for reviewer-specific review checkpoint discovery and fail-closed global inbox routing.
name: Review Inbox Global v1
